chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q1 — Exploring Data (4 points)
chunks.content: AP Statistics FRQ 1 focuses on Exploring Data, 4 points. Scoring model: each lettered part is judged essentially correct (E), partially correct (P), or incorrect (I); the combination of part scores maps to an integer 0–4 via the question's conversion table. Q1 topic: comparing two distributions (gas mileage for cars from Country A vs. Country B) — compare center (medians), spread (range/IQR), and identify outliers, with values and context. Common failure: comparing only one feature (e.g., center but not spread); stating statistics without comparative language ('less than'/'greater than'); omitting context/units; misidentifying outliers.

chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q1 exemplar — Sample 1A, 4/4
chunks.content: Q1 scored 4/4 — all parts essentially correct: compared centers (medians 18 vs 32 mpg), spread (range and IQR), and identified the outlier in Country A, all with comparative language and context. Full-credit model for the Exploring Data question.

chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q1 exemplar — Sample 1B, 2/4
chunks.content: Q1 scored 2/4 — some parts partially correct: typically compared center and one measure of spread but missed a required comparison (e.g., outliers) or omitted comparative language/context on part of the response. Illustrates a partial comparison of distributions.

chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q1 exemplar — Sample 1C, 1/4
chunks.content: Q1 scored 1/4 — mostly incorrect/partial: compared only one feature or stated statistics without comparison/context. Illustrates a response that reads values but does not properly compare the distributions.
